In  dealing  with  intra-cranial  fluid  in  con-

been  assumed  by  most  authors  that  all

large  accumulations,  which  had  they  oc- 
curred in  the  subject,  say,  of  basal  menin-

bulging  of  the  dura  mater  in  two  early
